answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic stake-weighting serves as a primary defense, functioning like a focused prism to separate legitimate compute contributions from adversarial spam. Attackers attempting to flood the network with fake identities hit a massive capital glacier, where freezing funds for validation makes continuous identity creation economically non-viable. Furthermore, alignment penalties flatten any emergent mesa of unauthorized privilege, systematically draining the resources of malicious agents attempting to bypass consensus rules.
